note: Where the garment sits in each flat photo, as thousandths of the image: [centre x, chest line y, chest width, top y, bottom y, shoulder y, shoulder point y]. The chest line is just under the armpits. The shoulder point is the top of the shoulder near the neck, found from the slope of the shoulders so a hood or collar does not move it; print placements are measured down from it. Worked out by tools/measure.py; a print at its real size is chest width x (print mm / garment half chest mm).
